title: Re-construction of Pump House, toilet block and special repair & maintenance at Korlai Fort Lighthouse Station.
summary: Percentage-rate e-tender to rebuild the pump house and toilet block and carry out special repairs, pathway, gate, water supply and painting works at Korlai Fort Lighthouse, Raigad, Maharashtra.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, M.G. Road, Ghatkopar (East), Mumbai

sites.name: Korlai Fort Lighthouse, P.O. Korlai, Ta. Murud, Dist. Raigad 402202, Maharashtra
sites.work: Re-construction of pump house and toilet block; special repair and maintenance of LH tower, IQ, HLK and NA-II quarters; pathway, compound wall, gates; painting; water supply

scope.item: (A) Dismantling/demolishing: jungle clearance (480 sqm), doors/windows (47 each), wash basins (10), WC pans (6), GI pipes (30 Rmt), steel work (236 kg), tile work (110 sqm), RCC (26.1 cum), stone rubble masonry in CM (144.1 cum)

(B) Pump house and new toilet block: anti-termite treatment (25 Rmt), excavation in hard rock (10.1 cum), filling (124 cum), PCC 1:3:6 (33.9 cum), stone masonry in foundation (15 cum), fly ash brick work (33.2 cum)
RCC 1:1.5:3 in lintels/beams (3.55 cum), chajjas (0.3 cum), slab (3.15 cum); centering and shuttering (61.32 sqm); TMT Fe-500D reinforcement (SAIL/TATA/JSW)
Black granite 18 mm for platforms/vanity counters

Doors: 35 mm decorative flush door shutters (6.75 sqm), 30 mm FRP flush door shutters (19.2 sqm), 37 mm PVC door shutter (2.1 sqm), with brass locks, handles, tower bolts, stoppers and hydraulic door closers
uPVC two-track sliding window R4 series (1.3 sqm), PU sealant to frames (306.5 Rmt), MS grills (60 kg)
Plastering: 15 mm CM 1:4 (60 sqm), 18 mm two-coat plaster (190 sqm), 25 mm SBR polymer modified mortar (46 sqm)
3 mm APP modified five layer waterproofing membrane
Vitrified floor tiles 600x600 (16.5 sqm) and ceramic wall tiles (24 sqm) (Johnson/Kajaria/Nelco)
CPVC pipes concealed 15/20/25 mm (26 Rmt each), 32 mm (39 Rmt), 40 mm exposed (45 Rmt)

Sanitary: wall hung syphonic WCs (4), urinal with auto flushing cistern (1), wash basins (7), SS kitchen sink (1), mirrors (3), towel rails, napkin holders, soap dishes (4 each), glass shelves (10), CP curtain rods (70 Rmt), water supply fittings
110 mm uPVC rain water pipe (30 Rmt) with fittings; gully chamber (1); masonry septic tank 5 users (1); soak pit (1)

(C) Special repair & maintenance of LH tower, IQ, HLK, NA-II quarters: repair/refix door shutters (20), chipping unsound concrete 75 mm (310 sqm) and 25 mm (46 sqm), rust removal on rebars (644 Rmt), epoxy bonding (46 sqm), polymer plaster patch repair (159 sqm), epoxy tile grouting (220 sqm), pointing on stone work (650 sqm), replacement fittings
Replace PVC overhead water tanks: remove damaged tanks (8), supply polyethylene tanks (Sintex/National)

(D) Internal pathway and gates: precast M-25 kerb stone (2.5 cum), 60 mm M-35 paver blocks (660 sqm), GI C-class pipe hand rail (740 kg), FRP security cabin (1, GeM product id 5116877-27178978599), modular toilet for disabled users (1, Mantra Composites), wicket gate 0.90x2.00 m (1), main gate 3.70x2.00 m (1), granite name board 90x120 cm (1), department emblem granite plate 60x130 cm (1)

(E) Painting: synthetic enamel on lighthouse tower (349 sqm), putty and primer (30 sqm each), interior acrylic emulsion (1640 sqm), exterior acrylic with silicone (1310 sqm), PU floor paint (475 sqm), epoxy on steel (165.04 sqm) and concrete (40 sqm), French polish (20 sqm)
(F) Water supply: 50 mm CPVC external pipe (60 Rmt), 50 mm gun metal gate valves (20), 1.5 HP open well submersible pump min 45 m head (Kirloskar/Crompton/Texmo) (1), 1.5 HP digital control panel (1)
Recovery of scrap: RCC steel 660 kg @ Rs 15, doors 24 @ Rs 1,000, windows/ventilators 17 @ Rs 500 (credit)
Disposal of rubbish/malba by mechanical transport up to 10 km

money.performance_security: Performance guarantee 5% of contract value (FDR/BG) before work order; plus security deposit 5% deducted from RA bills, released after 6 months defect liability period
money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST; BOQ total Rs 53,90,735.28 net of scrap recovery credit of Rs 42,400. EMD by DD/FDR of scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Mumbai, valid three months; MSME/NSIC bidders must also pay EMD. Minimum average annual turnover 30% of estimate (Rs 16,17,220).

period.completion: 06 months from the date of award of contract
period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Registered licensed contractors/firms of appropriate category with Central Govt./State Govt./Municipal Corporation, with tender limit equal to or more than estimated cost

Similar works (civil construction, repair and maintenance) in last 7 years with Central/State/UT Government organisations: three works each >= Rs 21.56 lakh (40%), or two each >= Rs 32.34 lakh (60%), or one >= Rs 43.13 lakh (80%); sub-contractor experience not considered
Average annual turnover at least 30% of estimated cost over last 3 financial years, CA certified
PAN, GST registration, income tax returns for three years
Tender acceptance letter, unconditional bid undertaking, bid securing declaration, notarised non-blacklisting affidavit, declaration of no relatives in DGLL/MoPSW
Technical evaluation score of at least 70/100 (statutory 30, financial 20, experience 20, client performance certificates 20, key personnel 10)
specs: Works to CPWD specifications; approved makes include Jaquar/Parryware/Hindware sanitaryware, Johnson/Kajaria/Nelco tiles, Asian/Berger/Snowcem paints, SAIL/TATA/JSW rebars, Sintex/National tanks
Gates per drawings MUM/503/2025 and MUM/504/2025; name board per drawing B/3006; emblem per drawing MUM82303/2022; septic tank per standard drawing B/1831
notes: Full 70-page tender document; GCC/SCC and annexure forms are standard boilerplate. BOQ in Section VII labelled 'Percentage BoQ'. Bid download/submission 24/07/2025 16:00 to 18/08/2025 16:00; original EMD by 20/08/2025; technical bid opening 21/08/2025 16:00. Listing shows end 2025-08-20 (EMD date) and no opening date.
